title: Fluorescent In Vitro Model to Assess Adhesion and Invasion of Bd in PAK
author: Elin Verbrugghe
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8ihhub6

steps.title: Prepare Cell Medium A
steps.instruction: Mix L15 medium, distilled water, and fetal bovine serum to obtain a solution of 70 % L15, 20 % distilled water, and 10 % fetal bovine serum.

steps.title: Prepare Cell Medium B
steps.instruction: Mix L15 medium, distilled water, and fetal bovine serum to obtain a solution of 40 % L15, 55 % distilled water, and 5 % fetal bovine serum.

steps.title: Coat Coverslips with Rat Tail Collagen
steps.instruction: Add glass coverslips to a 24‑well tissue‑culture plate, aspirate the collagen coating solution, add 200 µL per well, incubate at 37 °C for 2 h, then rinse twice with HBSS‑. Use immediately or air‑dry and store at 4 °C for up to one week.

steps.title: Label Primary Keratinocytes with CellTracker Green
steps.instruction: Work in the dark. Add 1 mL of 3 µM CellTracker Green CMFDA prepared in cell medium A to the primary keratinocytes (PAK), resuspend gently, and incubate 30 min at 20 °C, 5 % CO₂. Centrifuge 5 min at 1500 rpm, 20 °C; discard supernatant and resuspend pellet in 70 % HBSS‑ while counting cells. Centrifuge again 5 min at 1500 rpm, discard supernatant, and resuspend cells in cell medium A to 1 × 10⁵ cells · mL⁻¹. Seed 1 mL (1 × 10⁵ cells) per well onto the collagen‑coated coverslip, incubate 1 h at 20 °C, 5 % CO₂, then wash once with 70 % HBSS⁺. Include a control well for microscopy monitoring.

steps.title: Label Bd Zoospores with CellTracker Red
steps.instruction: Work in the dark. Isolate Bd zoospores and centrifuge 5 min at 3000 rpm, 20 °C. Remove supernatant and resuspend spores in a 3 µM CellTracker Red CMPTX solution prepared in cell medium B; incubate 45 min at 20 °C. Centrifuge 3 min at 3000 rpm, discard supernatant, resuspend spores in cell medium B, count, and dilute to 1 × 10⁶ spores · mL⁻¹ in cell medium B. Note that spores lose motility in cell medium A. Include a control well for motility monitoring.

steps.title: Infect PAK Cells with Bd Spores
steps.instruction: Work in the dark. Add 1 mL of the spore suspension (1 × 10⁶ spores) to each well containing CellTracker‑green‑labelled PAK cells (MOI = 10:1). Incubate 2 h at 20 °C, 5 % CO₂. Gently wash infected cells three times with 70 % HBSS⁺ to remove non‑adherent spores. Replace cell medium B with cell medium A and incubate either 2 h (to assess adhesion) or 22 h (to assess invasion). Use the control well to monitor adhesion/invasion by light microscopy.

steps.title: Visualize Adhesion and Invasion Interactions
steps.instruction: Work in the dark. For adhesion analysis, examine cells at 4 h post‑infection (2 h in medium B + 2 h in medium A); for invasion, examine at 24 h post‑infection (2 h in medium B + 22 h in medium A). Wash infected cells three times with 70 % HBSS⁺, fix with 0.5 mL of 3 % paraformaldehyde for 10 min, stain nuclei with Hoechst, wash twice with 70 % HBSS⁺, mount coverslips with ProLong Gold antifade mountant, and analyze using fluorescence and confocal laser‑scanning microscopy.
